title: Fix KDE Plasma ignoring system locale settings
summary: If KDE Plasma continues to use the wrong language despite changing the system locale, deleting a specific configuration file usually resolves the issue.
error_patterns: KDE Plasma also allows to change the UI's language through the system settings. If the desktop environment is still using the default language after the modification

steps.explain: Delete the KDE-specific locale configuration file that overrides system settings.
